intent: Give the surface a spatial structure a reader can predict.
moves: Group related elements by proximity before reaching for a border or a card.
Make the gap between groups at least twice the gap within a group.
Align every element to a shared edge; a single stray alignment reads as a bug.
Choose one column count and hold it, rather than varying it per section.
Set section rhythm from one spacing value multiplied, not from arbitrary numbers.
avoid: Cards inside cards, which double the padding and halve the clarity.
Centring everything, which removes the alignment edge the eye follows.
Equal spacing everywhere, which erases the grouping information spacing carries.
